message_text: Can I bring my car to campus as a freshman?
Freshmen can purchase a parking permit for $450/semester. However, availability is limited and permits are assigned by lottery.
$450 per semester?! That's insane. Is there free parking anywhere?
There is a free park-and-ride lot about 1 mile from campus with a shuttle that runs every 15 minutes during the academic year.
The shuttle is better than nothing I guess. What are the hours?
The shuttle runs Monday-Friday 7am-10pm and Saturday 9am-6pm. It does not run on Sundays or university holidays.
